description: Mock API request samples for Profile Builder endpoints - Use these for testing POST/PUT/PATCH operations
important: POST requests do NOT include 'id' field - server auto-generates prefixed IDs (prof_, exp_, edu_, cert_, cont_, etc.)

createProfile.description: Create a new profile shell (entities saved separately). Server generates prefixed ID (prof_*).
createProfile.note: No 'id' in request body - server generates it

createExperience_fullTime.description: Create a new full-time work experience entry (profileId in URL path). Server generates prefixed ID (exp_*).

request.title: Senior Software Engineer
request.summary: Leading development of cloud-native applications and microservices architecture. Managing a team of 5 engineers and driving technical strategy for the platform team.
highlights: Architected and implemented a microservices platform serving 2M+ daily active users
Reduced API response times by 60% through caching and query optimization
Mentored 5 junior engineers and conducted technical training sessions
Led migration from monolith to microservices, improving deployment frequency by 10x

createExperience_freelance.description: Create a new freelance/contract experience entry (profileId in URL path)

request.title: Freelance Full Stack Developer
request.summary: Built custom web applications for various clients using modern tech stack.
highlights: Developed 15+ client projects from concept to deployment
Specialized in React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL

createExperience_internship.description: Create a new internship experience entry (profileId in URL path)

request.title: Software Engineering Intern
request.summary: Summer internship focused on backend development and API design.
highlights: Built RESTful API endpoints serving 10K+ daily requests
Received return offer for full-time position

createExperience_volunteer.description: Create a new volunteer experience entry (profileId in URL path)

request.title: Volunteer Software Developer
request.summary: Developed pro bono software for local nonprofits.
highlights: Built donor management system used by 3 organizations
Mentored junior volunteers in software development

updateExperience.description: Partially update an existing experience entry (only provided fields are updated, profileId in URL path)

request.title: Lead Software Engineer
highlights: Architected and implemented a microservices platform serving 3M+ daily active users
Reduced API response times by 70% through caching and query optimization
Mentored 8 junior engineers and conducted technical training sessions
Led migration from monolith to microservices, improving deployment frequency by 15x
Implemented CI/CD pipelines reducing deployment time by 80%

createEducation_bachelors.description: Create a new bachelor's degree entry (profileId in URL path). Server generates prefixed ID (edu_*).

createEducation_masters.description: Create a new master's degree entry (profileId in URL path)

createEducation_bootcamp.description: Create a new coding bootcamp entry (profileId in URL path)

updateEducation.description: Partially update an existing education entry (only provided fields are updated, profileId in URL path)

createCertification_aws.description: Create AWS certification (profileId in URL path). Server generates prefixed ID (cert_*).

createCertification_kubernetes.description: Create Kubernetes certification (profileId in URL path)

createCertification_scrum.description: Create Scrum certification (profileId in URL path)

updateCertification.description: Partially update an existing certification (only provided fields are updated, profileId in URL path)

createSkills_bulk.description: Add multiple skills at once (free-form text, like adding tags). Server generates integer IDs. Accepts whatever user types - no validation against catalog. Background job will match to reference later.
createSkills_bulk.note: Skills are case-insensitive and allow any text. Duplicates (case-insensitive) within request or existing profile are rejected.

createSkills_single.description: Add a single skill (still accepts as array for consistency)

updateSkills_bulk.description: Partially update multiple skills at once (array with IDs). Only provided fields are updated. Cannot change the skill name itself, only metadata.

deleteSkills_bulk.description: Remove multiple skills from profile at once (bulk delete with array of IDs)

lookupSkills_bulk.description: INTERNAL: Find or create multiple skills in the reference catalog (used by background matching job, not called directly by profile endpoints)
lookupSkills_bulk.note: Background job uses this to match free-form skill names to canonical reference.skills. Returns array with { success, index, name, data: { id, ... }, created: true/false }

searchSkills.description: Search skills catalog for autocomplete (queries reference.skills with ILIKE)
searchSkills.note: Returns matching skills from master catalog for typeahead suggestions

createContactInfo.description: Create contact information (one-to-one with profile). Server generates prefixed ID (cont_*). Required fields: firstName, lastName, email. Returns 409 if already exists. ProfileId comes from URL path.

request.summary: Experienced software engineer with 8+ years building scalable web applications and cloud infrastructure. Passionate about clean code, system design, and mentoring junior developers. Strong background in full-stack development, microservices architecture, and DevOps practices. Seeking opportunities to lead technical teams and drive innovation in fast-paced environments.

createContactInfo.note: Social links (linkedin, twitter, etc.) are managed via the social_platforms schema, not here.

updateContactInfo_partial.description: Partially update existing contact info (PATCH semantics - only provided fields are updated). Returns 404 if doesn't exist. Both profileId and contact id come from URL path.
updateContactInfo_partial.note: Only updates the fields provided. Other fields remain unchanged. Must provide contact ID in URL (e.g., /profile/prof_123/contact/cont_456)

deleteContactInfo.description: Delete contact information. Both profileId and contact id come from URL path.
deleteContactInfo.note: Must provide contact ID in URL (e.g., /profile/prof_123/contact/cont_456)

invalidDateRange_experience.expectedError: VALIDATION_ERROR - endDate must be after startDate

notes.idGeneration: POST requests do NOT include 'id' field. Server auto-generates: prof_* (profiles), exp_* (experience), edu_* (education), cert_* (certifications), cont_* (contact), integer IDs for skills.
notes.fieldMapping: Request uses camelCase (e.g., profileId, employmentType). Database uses snake_case (e.g., profile_id, employment_type).
